item.title: Amgen Obesity Trials & Maritide
item.description:
• Summary: Amgen has initiated a late-stage obesity trial for its investigational drug Maritide (AMG 133), specifically designed for patients who switch from rival GLP-1 receptor agonist therapies. The trial aims to demonstrate superior weight loss or metabolic benefits versus switching to another drug. Amgen is positioning Maritide as a potential best-in-class monthly obesity treatment, leveraging its dual mechanism of action. The company also presented data supporting improved tolerability and compliance over daily injections.
  • MoAs: GLP-1 receptor agonist and GIP receptor antagonist
  • Sources: Endpoints News, BioSpace
